admission.justification: Spans nine modules across citations, currentness, writer, conversion, recorded reads, and test-isolation state census, and is guarded by LanguageSet cache-isolation, definition-scope, and process-state tests.

applicability: Every citation, anchor, conversion, currentness, and test-isolation consumer resolving source bindings through LanguageSet.
conditions: Language resolution runs through the active LanguageSet ContextVar and LanguageProvider protocol rather than a process-global suffix table.
LanguageSet.extractor_version deterministically incorporates pinned tree-sitter and provider versions plus .scm query digests.
Definition, parse, TypeScript anchor, BLOB_DEFINITIONS, observation, and CodeObjects caches key by active provider identity or restrict process-global reuse to the default LanguageSet.
tags_engine.compile_query is registered in PROCESS_MUTABLE_STATES for module-boundary test cleanup.
exclusions: Legacy format 1 conversion retains its explicit historical CitationReader language selection.
statement: Language resolution runs through the active LanguageSet ContextVar and LanguageProvider protocol, deriving EXTRACTOR_VERSION from pinned versions and query digests and threading provider identity into every definition, parse, anchor, and observation cache key.
title: LanguageSet seam derives extractor version and isolates anchor caches
